# WeekCalendar

A week of an activity plan, compact: the days across (today marked), and for each activity its name small above a row of stars: not planned (a dot), planned (an outline star), partly done (a pale star) or done (a gold star). A row that links to its activity is one link, name and stars.

<!-- rules:start — GENERATED by tools/build_tokens.py from design/components.json -->
## Rules (every product)

- Days Monday to Sunday with their dates; today's column on lilac. Each activity: its name small above its stars, one dashed rule under the row, as on the practice week (Tracker) but compact: icon-sized stars in rows just taller than a star.
- Not planned: a small dot. Planned: a purple outline star. Partly done: a pale sun star. Done: a gold star outlined in sun-deep.
- A row can link to its activity: the whole row (name and stars) is one link, a chevron after the name, read out as the name and each day.
- A row can be tapped to add or take away a star (practice): its stars stay 44px targets. The others are read-only.
- Adding a star bursts: the star springs in with a twist and sparkles fly out (purple, teal, sun, pink). Not with reduced motion.
- Never colour alone: filled against outline, and each day is read out (Monday, Morning routine: done).

Tokens: `component.calendar` (none, planned, partial, partial-line, done-fill, done-line, burst-sun, burst-purple, burst-teal, burst-pink, today, ink, day-ink, rule) in design/tokens.json.

| Product | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Website | none: The website has no plans. |
| Design System | `.fmt-calendar`, `<WeekCalendar>` |
| App | `FmtWeekCalendar` |
